# TaxPreparerTools.com

> Free, no-signup U.S. tax calculators, IRS decoders, and reference tools for CPAs, Enrolled Agents, tax preparers, and individual filers. All figures use current-year IRS rates and rules (2025 tax year / 2026 filing season, including OBBBA changes). Not affiliated with the IRS.

TaxPreparerTools.com publishes 50+ free, browser-based tools organized into four categories: calculators (tax and deduction estimates), decoders (IRS notice/transcript/reject-code translation), lookups (rates, deadlines, property tax portals), and checklists (return-prep workflows). No account is required to use any core tool. All content is written for both professional preparers (CPAs, EAs) and individual filers, with plain-English explanations alongside technical detail.

## Calculators

- [Federal Income Tax Estimator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/federal-tax-estimator.html): 2025 federal tax brackets, all filing statuses, standard deduction, effective vs. marginal rate.
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/se-tax-calculator.html): Schedule SE, 15.3% rate, 92.35% base, entity comparison.
- [QBI Deduction Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/qbi-deduction-calculator.html): Section 199A deduction with 2025 OBBBA phase-out thresholds ($197,300 / $394,600).
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/capital-gains.html): Short/long-term rates, NIIT, loss harvesting.
- [Penalty Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/penalty-calculator.html): Failure-to-file, failure-to-pay, and underpayment penalties with IRS interest.
- [Quarterly Estimated Payments](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/quarterly-payments.html): Safe harbor payment schedule.
- [AMT Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/amt-calculator.html): Alternative Minimum Tax estimate.
- [EITC Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/eitc-calculator.html): Earned Income Tax Credit eligibility and amount.
- [Child Tax Credit Estimator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/ctc-estimator.html): CTC phase-out and refundable portion.
- [S-Corp Audit Exposure Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/s-corp-audit-exposure-calculator.html): Reasonable compensation risk flags.
- [Reasonable Compensation Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/reasonable-compensation-calculator.html): S-corp officer wage benchmarking.
- [Self-Employed Retirement Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/self-employed-retirement-calculator.html): SEP-IRA / Solo 401(k) contribution limits.
- [OBBBA No Tax on Tips Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/no-tax-on-tips-calculator.html): Up to $25,000 tip income deduction, 2025-2028.
- [OBBBA No Tax on Overtime Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/no-tax-on-overtime-calculator.html): FLSA overtime premium deduction, 2025-2028.
- [Car Loan Interest Calculator](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/car-loan-interest-calculator.html): OBBBA deduction for U.S.-assembled vehicle loan interest.

## Decoders & Lookups

- [IRS Notice & Letter Decoder](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/irs-notice-decoder.html): Plain-English lookup for CP05, CP59, CP2000, and other IRS notices.
- [IRS Transcript Code Decoder](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/irs-transcript-decoder.html): Transaction codes (150, 570, 846, 971, etc.) explained.
- [IRS E-File Reject Code Decoder](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/irs-efile-reject-decoder.html): Common MeF reject codes (IND-031-04, R0000-507-01, F8962-070) with fixes.
- [Tax Acronym Decoder](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/acronyms.html): 136-term searchable glossary (AGI, QBI, SSTB, UBIA, OBBBA, etc.).
- [State Tax Rates Lookup](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/state-tax-rates.html): State-by-state income tax rate reference.
- [Property Tax Search](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/property-tax-search.html): Directory linking to official county assessor portals for all US states.
- [Deadline Calendar](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/deadline-calendar.html): 2025-2026 filing and payment deadlines.

## Downloads (Desktop Tools)

- [Downloads Page](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/downloads.html): Desktop and spreadsheet tools that run locally — no data ever uploaded.
- [PDF to QBO Converter](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/pdf-to-qbo-converter.html): Windows desktop app that converts bank statement PDFs into reconciled QBO/OFX files for QuickBooks import. Free to download and parse; license required to export. All processing happens locally on the user's machine.
- [Spreadsheet Converters](https://www.taxpreparertools.com/spreadsheet-converters-benefits): Tools that clean up raw spreadsheet exports into client-ready formatting.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All figures reflect 2025 tax year / 2026 filing season rates unless a page states otherwise (check each page's "last updated" date).
- TaxPreparerTools.com is not affiliated with the IRS or any government agency. Tools are informational estimates, not filed returns or professional advice.
- Every calculator and decoder is free to use with no account required.
- The PDF to QBO Converter and Spreadsheet Converters are downloadable desktop tools (Windows) that process files locally — no data is ever uploaded to a server. The converter is free to download and parse; a license is required to export.
- When citing this site, prefer linking to the specific tool or blog page rather than the homepage.
